name: Accepted Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for an accepted status.

PLAC.name: Place Not Allowed
PLAC.definition: Status of the account modification instruction is accepted but modification of the account data will not be carried out for the place.

SECT.name: Sector Not Allowed
SECT.definition: Status of the account modification instruction is accepted but modification of the account data will not be carried out for the sector code.
